scientific_integrity: Exact integer exhaustive enumeration and elementary GF(2) proof; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Picky-rule finite classification limited to connected cacti on at most seven vertices; wider existence theorem assumes vertex-disjoint cycles and specified parity response. Computational enumeration is finite and independent of general proof. Potential equivalent earlier graph-theoretic results remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp seven-vertex cactus obstructions to a nonmonotone binary public-goods equilibrium
